all_roi_protocol: Compare the same near-4K crop from each x6 composite against the x6 Global background. The crop is the Local projection bounding box with 24 native-canvas pixels of margin; all methods use the same ROI and feather radius.
interpretation_limit: PSNR/SSIM measure similarity to the x6 Global reference over this ROI, not ground-truth stitching quality. Global-retained pixels in the three-region output match that reference by construction and affect these scores.
